model_settings.value: Voxel-wise multiple regression included age, oleoylethanolamide levels, obesity grouping, sex, Beck Depression Inventory scores, and all obesity-group-related two-way interactions with these variables. Oleoylethanolamide and age were orthogonalized; orthogonalized oleoylethanolamide and Beck Depression Inventory scores were ranked because of nonnormality. Family-wise error correction was applied in predefined regions of interest.

Participants had a standardized breakfast of 500 kcal (2093 kJ) 6 hours before fMRI scanning during which we presented 18 blocks of food stimuli and 12 blocks of neutral stimuli during a time frame of 18 minutes, as previously described.

description.value: Neutral cues taken from the International Affective Picture Series, avoiding food-related items.

spans.text: Food cravings were assessed after each block using a visual analog scale ranging from very weak to very strong (values 0 to 100)

stimuli.value: Eighteen blocks of food stimuli and 12 blocks of neutral stimuli were presented over 18 minutes. Food stimuli comprised salty high-calorie, sweet high-calorie, and low-calorie salty and sweet images; neutral cues came from the International Affective Picture Series and excluded food-related items. Each block contained five stimuli of the same category, shown for 4 seconds each.
